Question 1

a
11+t⟨1,t2,2t⟩
b
11+t2⟨−1,t2,2t⟩
c
11+t2⟨−1,t2,2t⟩
d
11+t⟨−1,t2,22t⟩
e
11+t2⟨−1,t2,2t2⟩
